brief: Enter at (29.75377, -90.12886): Priority 1, closest to 5 isolated buildings [F3]. Enter at (29.75406, -90.12862): Priority 2, closest to 4 isolated buildings [F4]. Buildings include 9 isolated cut off from every exit road, 13 uncertain, 2 still reachable, 24 with no mapped road nearby [F2]. 47 road pieces were checked: 10 judged flooded, 35 uncertain, the rest judged dry [F1]. Flood judgements come from a vision model reading satellite photos, not field-verified; uncertain roads need a drone or ground check [F6]. Testing on 20 SpaceNet 8 tiles marked 1 of 666 truly cut-off buildings reachable, and isolated calls were right depending on area roughly 4 to 5 in 10 where most buildings could still get out and 98 in 100 where nearly all were cut off; treat isolated as a reason to check, not a confirmed cut-off [F5].

facts.F1: 47 road pieces were checked: 10 judged flooded, 35 uncertain, the rest judged dry.
facts.F2: Buildings: 9 isolated (cut off from every exit road), 13 uncertain, 2 still reachable, 24 with no mapped road nearby.
facts.F3: Priority 1: enter at map reference (29.75377, -90.12886); a crew entering here is closest to 5 isolated buildings.
facts.F4: Priority 2: enter at map reference (29.75406, -90.12862); a crew entering here is closest to 4 isolated buildings.
facts.F5: In testing on 20 SpaceNet 8 tiles, 1 of 666 truly cut-off buildings was marked reachable. How often an 'isolated' call was right depended on the area: roughly 4 to 5 in 10 where most buildings could still get out, and 98 in 100 where nearly all were cut off. Treat 'isolated' as a reason to check, not a confirmed cut-off.
facts.F6: Flood judgements come from a vision model reading satellite photos and are not field-verified; uncertain roads need a drone or ground check.
